nodes.label: v3/CONSTANTS.md — the constants and tunables inventory for v3/: 467 rows, each naming the file and symbol, the value, what it controls, and where that value came from. check_constants.py at the repo root parses the table, re-reads each named symbol out of the source with ast and compares the recorded value against the code's, and v3/test_constants_inventory.py fails the suite on drift.

What the inventory covers: every hard-coded constant and tunable in v3/ — module-level constants, environment-variable defaults (name and default recorded), and numeric or string literals acting as a threshold, limit, cap, k, temperature, batch size, timeout, tolerance, seed, model id, prompt or dimension, including ones in function signature defaults, inline in expressions, and inside Cypher strings. Trivially structural literals (0/1 as index or identity, list indices, obvious loop bounds, message-truncation slices in error strings) are out, as are the test files (v3/test_*.py, v3/artefact/tests/), which set no runtime behaviour.

unknown is the point of the provenance column: no evidence for the value was found anywhere — not in the user's turns, not in a design doc, not in a git message, not in a sweep, not in the code's own comments. It is not a judgement that the value is wrong, and it is never a guess dressed up as a reason. A rationale written in a comment after the fact is not evidence of derivation and is recorded as unknown with the comment quoted.

derived is the strict class: the value is forced by something outside the choice — a name the code or the dataset already carries, a schema or a library's requirement, an arithmetic identity, or a decision with a citation. "Outside" excludes the code's own prose: a comment, docstring or help string is written by whoever wrote the value, so it can describe a derivation but never be one, and the citation has to reach something existing independently of this repo's source — the dataset's own file shape, a vendor's published limit, a library's contract, a paper or dataset card, a user turn, a design doc, or a measurement in a run folder. Where a rule's shape follows from something real but its number does not — a numerical guard's magnitude, a rounding precision, a budget sized with headroom — the row is unknown and states both halves. A reason that restates the value's effect is unknown, as is a name the code invents for its own artefact; a path pointing at content another stage writes stays derived, because the two must agree.

The where column names the file and the symbol, never a line number. Two backticked parts — `file` · `SYMBOL` — is a module-level assignment; three — `file` · `scope` · `literal` — is a literal with no symbol of its own, located by its enclosing function (or by the Cypher constant it sits inside) and quoted.

Across the 20 numeric tunables and flags of artefact_v1.py — W_TAG, W_DESC, W_SCOPE, STR_FACET, STR_WCHUNK, STR_RELEVANCE, STR_DESC_HINT, STR_SCOPE_MATCH, STR_GUIDE, K_LEVELS, GUIDE_TAU, GUIDE_C, GUIDE_M, GUIDE_LAMBDA, GUIDE_SEED, AGG, NORM, NORM_SCOPE, KNN_OVERFETCH, CURVE_WALK — git log -p --follow shows no assignment line ever removed or modified: each is at its first-commit value. The claim covers those 20 lines and nothing else; model ids in particular are outside it (INTERPRET_MODEL has carried three values). DESC_HINT_M and DESC_CUT are younger tunables outside the claim: DESC_HINT_M was added by bb95e4b (2026-08-05, "tags route and weight, never exclude"), and being younger than the runs both are in none of them — RETRIEVAL_FLAGS carries HERB_DESC_HINT_M and HERB_DESC_CUT (33 entries, 34 on the det leg) but no run_manifest.json under v3/output/ records either, so every figure quoted in the file was produced under a flag schema that differs from today's, and neither the value 2.0 nor the description cut has been varied or measured.

The 2026-07-23 combine sweep and the 2026-08 weight sweeps ran around these defaults without changing any of them, and where a sweep produced a winner it was not adopted (HERB_NORM_SCOPE: sweep global 0.6812, shipped per_path 0.6039). So almost nothing in the artefact arm qualifies as swept under the definition "the value was selected by a sweep" — the sweeps are evidence about the values, not evidence for them, and rows say so.

No row marked swept names a run folder that is still on disk. Those folders were retrieval-only, were not retained, and — checked against git log --all --diff-filter=A — were never committed either, so they are unrecoverable rather than merely deleted. Each such row opens with 'evidence not retained' and states the figure as unsupported, because the only surviving record of it is v3/output/DATA_README.md, a sibling document in the same shipment, and a sibling document is not evidence. No row rests its class on DATA_README.md or docs/ENVIRONMENT.md: a figure either points at a run folder, a code line, a user turn or a dated state doc, or it is marked unsupported in place. CURVE_WALK and NORM_SCOPE are the cases where a surviving folder does carry the reading and the row names that folder.
Evidence keys used by the rows: turns:L<n> = docs/canon/raw/user_turns_all.md; state:<file> = the flat state-transfer folder under OneDrive; canon:<file> = docs/canon/.

Counts, recounted from the table by python check_constants.py --counts, which reads the rows back and tallies them so the classes sum to the total. Total rows 467: unknown 240, derived 186, borrowed 22, user-specified 14, swept 5. The tie-break, stated because three rows need one: a provenance cell may name two classes when a row's shape is forced but its wording or its number is not — the tagger SYSTEM, the interpreter SYSTEM and _EXCLUDE_RE each open derived and close unknown — and such a row is tallied as unknown, the weaker class winning because a row is only as supported as its least supported half; that is what check_constants.provenance_of does, scanning the fixed order unknown → derived → borrowed → user-specified → swept and returning the first class present. Reading the leading bold token instead would print unknown 237 / derived 190. python check_constants.py re-reads 310 of those rows against the source — 276 with a value the parser can compare on both sides, 34 where the symbol is verified but the value is prose or an expression it will not evaluate — and the remaining 157 name no module-level symbol and are reported UNCHECKED.

Two rows carry a disagreement between sources and say so in place: NIM_SECONDS_BETWEEN_CALLS, where the 3.0 s default and the comment beside it describe different rates, and HERB_NORM_SCOPE, where the sweep measures a different winner than the value that ships. Three rows describe _check_judge_context_budget, a function no call site invokes: MAX_JUDGE_CONTEXT_CHARS, _CONTEXT_HEAVY_LLM and the [:8] report cut.

What binds the artefact arm to its graph, all user-specified or derived. DATABASE / NEO4J_DATABASE = "herb-eval" is user-specified ("i want to retrieve the old 'post thesis cleaned up v1 graph', the one using 'herb-eval' db, and run the the current v3 arm and eval at k=50 on that one", turns:L344) and decides which Neo4j DB every artefact number comes from, including one half of the cluster-guide cache-entry name. DATASET_ID = "Salesforce__HERB" is the Source.name the v1 build wrote. RUN_ID = "pilot_full_herb" is the single run_id present in herb-eval. ALL_FACETS = (topic, entities, activity, temporal, evidence) is borrowed — the facet set baked into herb-eval's HAS_TAG.facets, and the canonical axis order of everything keyed by facet, folded into _INTERP_SIG so editing it invalidates every cached plan. GROUND_INDEX = tag_emb and DESC_INDEX = chunk_desc_emb are the index names reembed_herb_eval.py creates, both required present before a run starts. NEO4J_PASSWORD has no default and raises before a driver opens; NEO4J_URI and NEO4J_USER default to the Neo4j Bolt port and the install default.

K_LEVELS = (8, 16, 32, 64) — the doubling level sequence in _multi_k_support; the tag-pool width and both description-pool widths (K_LEVELS[-1] = 64); the extension base for stated scope; _n_levels's multiplicity; the level count in _ABS_REF; the sufficiency review's evidence ladder; and the knn_levels field of the retrieval meta. unknown, and named by the user as exactly the problem: "arbitrarily decided hard limits, like the 64 chunk limit, i bet there is way more than 1 of these dumb limits lying around not beeing seen" (turns:L4217; the 64 is K_LEVELS[-1]). OPEN_DECISIONS §15 and USER_CANON Part IV.C both list it as underived, and the measured consequence is "the distance term spans 1.41× while the level staircase spans 4× → K_LEVELS is the value model, not a budget". KNN_OVERFETCH = 4 is the over-fetch multiplier on both vector indexes, unknown and measured vacuous in its stated purpose: filter survival is exactly 1.0 on both indexes and Chunk.empty exists on 0 chunks, so every row filter is a no-op.

The cross-path combine weights. W_TAG = 1.0 weights the tag path in the cross-path sum and the tag term of the door trace — unknown: swept at 0 / 0.5 / 2 / 4 with none of those folders on disk, and the W_TAG=0 result is unsupported because neither record carrying it is primary (the state doc's "+0.027, t 2.56" against a Westfall–Young bar of +0.036, and DATA_README's "+0.0062, CI [−0.0040, +0.0165], W/L/T 4/2/94" cannot both be right — 6 nonzero deltas summing to a mean of +0.027 force t ≤ 2.514, so the state doc's pair is internally impossible). W_DESC = 1.0 and W_SCOPE = 1.0 are unknown and never varied in any run manifest under v3/output/. W_PERSON / HERB_W_PERSON = 1.0 is the one user-specified weight: the four path weights start at the same value — "why shouldnt they all start at the same?" / "fucking nail the 1.0 start" (2026-08-13) — it is the switch that is the path, since at 0.0 no directory is read, no person query runs, no chunk enters a pool through it and no person block reaches the meta, and a value below 0.0 fails loud at import.

The modifier strengths, lerped through _mod. STR_FACET = 0.0 (edge facet-agreement) is swept with evidence not retained and its figure unsupported — the inert 0.0 ships and no measurement selects it. STR_WCHUNK = 1.0 (edge magnitude, w_chunk) is unknown and never varied. STR_RELEVANCE = 1.0 is unknown and flagged as an open contamination channel: relevance_to_file was produced by a v1 LLM stage whose prompt contained the answer key and has never been ablated, and the circulating "all 35 manifests show 1.0" describes a population no longer on disk — 22 run_manifest.json files remain, 5 carrying HERB_STR_RELEVANCE, all at 1.0. STR_DESC_HINT = 1.0 and STR_SCOPE_MATCH = 1.0 are unknown and never varied. STR_PERSON_MATCH = 1.0 grades the person path's named-person match-fraction modifier and is unknown: the sibling strength STR_SCOPE_MATCH ships at the same value with the same absence of record.

DESC_HINT_M / HERB_DESC_HINT_M = 2.0 is the factor a scope-hint-matching description chunk carries into the description path's modifier, lerped by STR_DESC_HINT. unknown — nothing derives 2.0; it is exposed as an env coefficient and recorded in RETRIEVAL_FLAGS so a run's manifest carries the value it ran under, and it is named in the benchmark-validity record as one of three values whose origin cannot be closed.

DESC_CUT / HERB_DESC_CUT ships on and decides what the flat regime's description lookup admits: on, the anchor chunk's containing cluster out of _desc_area's dendrogram chain (_anchor_cluster — the first merge, since level 0 is the anchor alone), so the neighborhood's own geometry sets the width and the kNN trim is only the ceiling; off, the whole K_LEVELS[-1]-wide neighborhood. Chunks outside the admitted cluster enter neither the union pool nor the description base, and the admitted count is the chunks field of the walk entry. unknown — the user names the fixed width as the defect (turns:L4217) but no turn names a replacement rule, so cutting at the anchor's first merge is the code's own choice and so is shipping it on; younger than every run under v3/output/, so no manifest carries it and no measurement separates the two settings.

The person path's rows — the fourth support path's whole value model, every knob reaching RETRIEVAL_FLAGS. PERSON_ON is derived (W_PERSON > 0.0) and is the one test every person-path branch reads: the resolver at prepare and at answer time, the path's opening in both walk regimes, its meta block and its door-trace cell. The six role weights W_ROLE_SPEAKER / PARTICIPANT / REVIEWER / PR_AUTHOR / DOC_AUTHOR / MENTIONS all ship at 1.0 and are unknown: role weighting is an open decision of the person-path design and the uniform weight is the trial's configuration. MENTION_ROLE = "mentions" is the role name a MENTIONS edge reads under, since it carries no role property and the Cypher coalesces to this — unknown, this arm's own naming. PERSON_ROLE_W is derived: the five INVOLVES.role values the entity layer writes plus MENTION_ROLE, each at its own env knob, and a role outside it fails loud rather than scoring at an invented weight. _NEGATIVE_ROLES is the import-time guard's finding — a non-empty list fails loud naming every offending knob, so no run scores a chunk down for carrying a kind of link. PERSON_AMBIGUOUS = "all" is unknown: the no-gates ruling argues against dropping evidence a name does reach and the directory measurement bounds what none costs (530 employees spelled by 98 distinct names, 92 shared, so none retires the employee half of the path), but neither forces the policy. PERSON_NEAR is on, unknown and measured quiet — the near tier fires 0 times over 42,774 declared content leaves and resolves 201/201 directory names in both near forms. EMPLOYEE_JSON and CUSTOMERS_JSON are HERB's own metadata files in the oracle-stripped corpus view. The id literals _EID_LITERAL \beid_[0-9a-f]{8}\b, _EMP_LITERAL \bEMP_\d{6,12}\b and _CUST_LITERAL \bCUST-\d+\b are HERB's own id forms at the widths the entity layer minted from; _ID_SHAPE restates the three case-blind as the audit trail for a miscased id; _INITIAL_STOP = ("a", "i") is derived, since without it a Brown resolves to four real employee ids and I Brown to three; _NAME_TOKEN = [^\W_]+ is unknown, with the underscore outside the class so an id can never be read as a name.

The regime switches. CURVE_WALK / HERB_CURVE_WALK defaults off and selects the progressive-frontier walk over the flat regime, also switching the kept_k rule and the curve_walk meta block — swept, with the 10smoke folders behind the constant-cut comparison neither on disk nor in any commit, so that reading is unsupported; what is supported is the flag-isolated gold-100 pair, budget-matched at 478.0 vs 480.9 ids, 0.7492 (on) against 0.6812 (off), +0.0680, CI [+0.0306, +0.1053], sign-flip p 2.45e-4 — and isolating the flag is not isolating a mechanism, since it switches the stop rule, clusters the description path and changes the kept_k rule together. DOOR_TRACE is off, observability only, heavy. FRESH_INTERP is off, freezing the plan across a retrieval sweep so the comparison is not confounded by interpreter sampling. NO_REVIEW is off, so the sufficiency review runs.

Per-query K did not bind in the one surviving CURVE_WALK run: meta.curve_walk.kept is 50 on 100 of 100 questions and semantic has a minimum of 122, so kept_k = min(len(semantic), k) took the caller's k every time; the stop rule fired on all 100 (stopped true, 7–146 levels opened) and never reached the depth. That delta is ordering and membership — per-query K has never been measured on gold-100.

How the paths fold and scale. AGG = "sum" decides how a path folds a chunk's support over the parts that vouch for it, and an unknown value fails loud at import — swept with evidence not retained and the figures unsupported. NORM = "relative" scales each path's base before the weighted sum — swept, evidence not retained, unsupported. NORM_SCOPE = "per_path" min-maxes per path rather than globally over the union and is inert unless NORM is relative — unknown, and the measurement contradicts the shipped value on both legs: global reads 0.6812 against per_path 0.6039 on the model leg, and artefact_v1_detGLOB__gold100__probe (on disk) reads 0.7394 against the det default's 0.7339, +0.0055, CI [+0.0004, +0.0106], the one det-leg sweep delta whose CI excludes zero; no record explains keeping per_path. _ABS_REF_DIST = 0.5 is unknown and inert at the default; _ABS_UNIT = 4.0 is 1 / _ABS_REF_DIST ** 2; _ABS_REF = 16.0 is len(K_LEVELS) * _ABS_UNIT and inherits K_LEVELS's unknown provenance.

The cluster-guide constants, all unknown. STR_GUIDE = 0.0 is off — no cache load, no guide_stats, no guide meta block, and values below 0 fail loud at import — and swept with the figures unsupported. GUIDE_TAU = 0.01 is the membership-cell floor, cited by name in CONTRADICTION_MAP §2 as one of the arm's unbased constants. GUIDE_C = 128 is the number of k-means prototypes per facet. GUIDE_M = 1.5 is the fuzzifier, whose > 1.0 guard is derived while 1.5 itself has no record. GUIDE_LAMBDA = 0.05 is the participation floor λ in ω̃ = λ + (1−λ)·ω. GUIDE_SEED = 20260731 is the k-means++ seed, whose digits are the build date, not a property of the data. Each of the four names the cache entry, and GUIDE_CACHE_DIR = output/tag_cluster_cache is where it lands.

The interpreter's model-facing constants. INTERPRET_MODEL = "claude-haiku-4-5" drives both interpreter passes and the sufficiency review and is part of the interpretation cache key — unknown: the user names haiku for the Claude lane (turns:L1186) and for the evals (turns:L3820) and is aware the arm makes haiku calls (turns:L2865), but no turn names a model for the interpreter, and git shows three values with no rationale in any commit message. _PASS1_SYSTEM (the three-step interpretation prompt), _PASS2_SYSTEM (the five-facet scoring prompt and its declared 0.0–1.0 scale) and _REVIEW_SYSTEM (the {"sufficient": bool} contract) are agent-written prose, all unknown; _INTERP_SIG is derived — a sha256 over 2 prompts, FILLER, ALL_FACETS and 5 function sources, so a cached plan may only be served by the interpreter that would produce it now. FILLER is unknown, and the benchmark-validity record names "find" in this live set as one of five terms whose presence shows the question file was open when it was written. The interpreter runs at temperature 0 with 2 attempts and a 480.0 s timeout, pass-1 max_tokens 512, pass-2 1024, the neutral facet value 0.2, the facet clamp [0.0, 1.0], the review digest 240 chars per context and review max_tokens 128.

The section enums, all derived. GATE_SECTIONS is the full nine-name top-level section enum of a HERB product file, oracle sections included, and its one read site is OFFERED_SECTIONS, which subtracts EXCLUDED_SECTIONS — the interpreter is offered that subset, never the tuple. EXCLUDED_SECTIONS = (answerable_questions, unanswerable_questions, product_profile) are the sections retrieval can never return: the same strip artefact/derive_corpus.py performs, plus product_profile. _EXCLUDED_PARAM is the list form bound as $excludedSections in all four Cyphers. OFFERED_SECTIONS is the six-name enum named inside the pass-1 prompt, the whitelist _parse_gate validates the model's answer against, and the vocabulary the det leg matches literally.

_tag_affinity's lift, support × (1 + affinity) in _part_levels, multiplies tag support before the anchor argmax; affinity is a fraction in [0, 1], so the ceiling is 2×. unknown — an unflagged up-to-2× with no HERB_STR_* exposure and no manifest entry: "_tag_affinity is an unflagged ×2 applied before the anchor argmax — changes membership, no STR_*, in no manifest". The tag-pool width is k = K_LEVELS[-1] = 64 with fetch KNN_OVERFETCH × 64 = 256, and both description widths are the same 64 / 256 — these are the "64 chunk limit" the user named.

pipelines/artefact_v1_det.py — the deterministic leg. DATABASE is derived from the interpreting leg's DATABASE, since both legs query the same graph and the value is what the run manifest's graph block records for this leg. INTERPRET_MODEL = "deterministic" is a manifest label, not a model. _EID and _YEAR are HERB's id form and the 4-digit year. _FACET_MODE / HERB_DET_FACETS defaults to "" and selects which of the support / routing / edges facet placements run — unknown, with the detf/detA/detE/detR folders absent from disk and never committed, and the one surviving folder of that 2026-07-21 family carrying "retrieval_flags": null, so no HERB_DET_FACETS value was recorded in that era at all. FACETS_ON / ROUTING_ON / EDGES_ON are derived from _FACET_MODE. _ANCHOR_TEXTS (5 facet-meaning sentences) and _FACET_WORDS (4 keyword lists) are agent-written and unknown, with "reviewers"/"authors" in the live list named as evidence the question file was open. The neutral facet floor 0.2, the plan neutral vector 0.2 and the facet-direction epsilon 1e-9 are unknown; the triggered facet weight 1.0 is the scale's top; the routing disagreement clamp [0.0, 1.0] never binds, since disagreement is bounded by the sum of the question direction's two largest facet weights, at most 0.769231 over the 16 trigger patterns, so the attainable stretch ceiling is 1.7692×.

pipelines/artefact_v1_relevance_weight.py — the multi-step relevance weight. The arm reads the derived facet layer out of build_facet_layer.py's cache entry and the herb-eval graph read-only, queries neither vector index, and so inherits none of K_LEVELS, KNN_OVERFETCH, the STR_* strengths or the path weights; the per-facet reliabilities, the corpus-expected demand and the query-activated region's width are measured rather than written, so they are not rows. DEMAND / HERB_DEMAND = "read" chooses whether the five facet weights are read from the query's own tag neighbourhood, held equal (flat), or taken as the read's deviation from the corpus-expected demand (centred), that expectation being the same read averaged at prepare over the chunk-description probe bank, which takes the weighting off the simplex so a facet the prompt wants less than the corpus does subtracts — unknown, with the measured decomposition showing 94.0% of an edge score is the flat component 0.2 * sum(phi_centred) and 4.3% a fixed tilt, both identical for every query, leaving 1.6% query-specific, two questions scoring edges at 0.985 correlation and sharing 90% of their top-500 edges. PHI_NEUTRAL = 0.5 is derived: the mid-rank CDF F = mean_rank/(n + 1) sends every facet column's median to ½, so centring anywhere else would score the absence of evidence. DIVIDE_FLOOR = 1e-6 is unknown. LAYER_ICC names the two facets whose reliability carries a build-measured ICC factor, derived from the two keys build_facet_layer.main writes. TAG_DISTANCE_CACHE_DIR = output/tag_distance_cache holds the float64 memmap the areas cluster from, stored at float64 because a narrower store cannot return the region's own product unchanged, named by a [:16] sha256 cut over the tag names and their vectors and marked complete by a manifest written last. The guide fit map max(0, 2·F − 1) is an arithmetic identity: the one linear map sending the calibrated median to 0 and the top to 1.

pipelines/artefact_v1_five_questions.py — five-questions matching. The arm reads the derived facet layer's edge list and the herb-eval graph read-only, queries neither vector index and makes no model call; the query is read deterministically as words and spans and the extracted spans embed through artefact_v1's shared per-text embed cache. The five questions are the user's own (his commits dba1160 and 48fbc9d); every default is the trial's configuration under the design's open decisions, each behind a flag and recorded in the manifest, selected by no measurement. ROLE_SOURCE = "derived" and ROLE_FIT = "raw" choose which layer the per-tag roles are recovered from and whether the five-slot fit is z-scored by the corpus spread before the argmax, both naming the cache entry. ENTITY_AGG and ACTIVITY_AGG = "max" fold a multi-name question's per-name matches. EVIDENCE_MATCH = "label" is agreement with the chunk's register-profile kind label rather than the rank-calibrated kind score. SILENT = "floor", with SILENT_FLOOR 0.0 (the match scale's own minimum) and SILENT_NEUTRAL 0.5, decides what chunk-side silence on an asked question contributes — a weight either way, never a cut. COMBINE = "additive" over additive / multiplicative / noisy-OR is unknown, because the combine is canonically undecided by the user's own ruling (turns:L4762), and MULT_FLOOR = 1e-6 exists because of the no-gates ruling (turns:L729), so a zero-valued match multiplies by the floor instead of annihilating the product. The five question weights W_TOPIC / W_ENTITIES / W_ACTIVITY / W_TEMPORAL / W_EVIDENCE all ship at 1.0, never varied. TIME_SCALE = 0.0 reads the dated chunks' own standard deviation at prepare, with DAY_SCALE_FLOOR 1.0 under it. The query readers — _MIXED_CAPS, _CAP_RUN, _NAME_STOP (24 words), _VERB_STEMS (60 stems), ACTION_WINDOW 6, the ISO-day / quarter / month / year regexes, _POSTURE_LATE (his own time_relevance enum, with the recency direction the code's reading), _KIND_FORMS and EVIDENCE_KIND_FEATURES — are agent-written under the design's open query-reader and taxonomy decisions, and a feature outside REGISTER fails loud at import. RETRIEVAL_FLAGS carries 14 entries plus HERB_FACET_PRIOR, the build knob naming the derived entry the roles are read under.

build_entity_graph.py — the versioned-copy build. SOURCE_DATABASE = "herb-eval" is read-only throughout and re-snapshotted by verify for the untouched proof; TARGET_DATABASE = "herb-eval-v2" is the OPEN-7 execution default under the user's 08-12 build order; PROTECTED_DATABASES = (herb, herb-eval, neo4j, system) are refused as write targets, with herb refused as a source too. DESIGN_DOC names docs/state/2026-08-12-entity-nodes-and-tag-cleanup-design.md, the authority every build manifest records, and EXECUTION_DEFAULTS copies that design's seven OPEN-1…OPEN-7 executor calls into every manifest, each still open as a ruling. The removal predicate's constants — R_URL_PREFIXES (https_, www_, github_com_, with bare http_ deliberately absent because its 14 tags are protocol concepts like http_2_connections), _GITHUB_PR, _X_PR, _PULL_REQUEST, _X_PULL and the slug separator — restate the design's §3.1. The gates are hard: EXPECTED_REMOVAL holds the design's censused 4,111 tags / 5,470 edges / 2,240 chunks touched / 0 emptied, EXPECTED_ENTITIES holds eight expected-count groups checked before anything is written and re-checked off the graph after, and EXPECTED_REMOVED_SHA256 = 6a279b3465f4ec55f440607d0239a4c56d1580ebd9582c43a4d31265b4426116 is the removed-name list's set identity, so matching counts over a different tag set stop the cleanup with nothing deleted. PERSON_LABEL / PRODUCT_LABEL / CHANNEL_LABEL are the design's node set, the Person node carrying id and kind only and no names anywhere; INVOLVES_TYPE, MENTIONS_TYPE, PRODUCT_TYPE = IN_PRODUCT and CHANNEL_TYPE = IN_CHANNEL are unknown, the executor's naming recorded in the manifest. _EID eid_[0-9a-f]{8}, _EMP EMP_\d{6,12} and _CUST CUST-\d+ are the three id-spaces; the role vocabulary is speaker / pr_author / reviewer / doc_author / participant, one per structured person field; the person kind labels eid / emp / cust / malformed are the tool's naming. _DB_NAME is Neo4j's database naming rule; CHECKSUM_REL_TOL 1e-6 exists because aggregation order is not fixed so bit-equality is not available; NODE_BATCH 500, REL_BATCH 2000, WRITE_BATCH 1000, DELETE_BATCH 500, INDEX_WAIT_S 600.0 and the 2.0 s index poll are unknown.

GRAPH_BUILD_DIR = output/graph_build is where graph_identity reads a database's build_manifest.json for the run manifest's graph block: a Neo4j-querying arm records the database name plus that record's removed_tags_sha256, timestamp and source_database; no readable record gives a null identity; a resumed run whose identity differs from the manifest's records every build under mixed_builds and never restamps; and a prior manifest that is unreadable, pre-field or malformed records as an unknown build, null, at the head of that list. derived — the directory build_entity_graph.py · BUILD_DIR writes a target database's build manifest into.

The one unenforced invariant — a relationship between constants the code depends on and nothing checks: _ANCHOR_TEXTS's keys must be ALL_FACETS, in the same order. _anchors() embeds _ANCHOR_TEXTS.values() as the rows of the anchor matrix while _facet_direction() builds the question's trigger vector by iterating _ANCHOR_TEXTS's keys and looking each name up in a dict built from ALL_FACETS, so the support shaper's G @ qdir and the router's (gap * qdir) pair anchor row i with trigger weight i only while the two sequences agree. A facet in ALL_FACETS and absent from _ANCHOR_TEXTS drops silently out of every direction vector while _FACET_WORDS can still fire its trigger; a key in _ANCHOR_TEXTS and absent from ALL_FACETS raises KeyError at the first det question. Nothing asserts the equality, no test covers it, and no comment mentions it.

The shared top-k budget, the inventory's clearest user-specified rows. orchestrator.DEFAULT_TOP_K = 50 is k for every arm on every run and run.py's -k default reads it — "so, for academic rigor, we have done k=50 now.. should we do more k's ?" (turns:L217), and he runs -k 50 himself (turns:L394, :3719) — with his later ruling limiting how it may be read: "k=50 does not mean the same for all arms, and thats retarded" (turns:L2901). Every arm's answer_one_question k default is the same 50, on the same citation.

pipelines/lucene.py — the sparse baseline, mostly borrowed. K1 = 0.9 and B = 0.4 are the BM25 term-saturation and length-normalization values published as the BEIR reference, and the method is bm25s's lucene variant, which reproduces Lucene's scoring exactly.

pipelines/vector.py — the dense baseline. EMBED_MODEL = "nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2" is the embedder this arm indexes with, one document per artifact embedded whole and scored by exact brute-force cosine.
pipelines/hybrid.py — the late-fusion baseline. ALPHA / HERB_HYBRID_ALPHA = 0.5 is the fusion weight between the lucene and vector rankings.
pipelines/artefact.py — the v3-native arm entry. DEFAULT_TOP_K = 10 is unknown and this arm keeps its own default rather than the harness's 50.

artefact/ — the native rebuild stages. CAP_TOKENS = 3000 is the chunk size cap every kind packs to, framed by the user himself as "a calibration seed, not a verdict" with a named sweep that was never run. The rest of the section covers the scan's hashing, the probe's RFC 6901 pointers, the chunker's boundaries, the tagger's model and batching, the oracle strip, the resolver's hash verification, the tag index and the graph store.

orchestrator.py — the run engine and the shared generator. DEFAULT_CORPUS = data/corpus/Salesforce__HERB is the only data a pipeline sees. DEFAULT_OUTPUT = output is unknown. DEFAULT_WORKERS = 2 is unknown and run.py overrides it to 1 anyway. MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES = 10 is unknown. GENERATOR_MODEL = "qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b" is the one answer-writer injected into every arm unless --generator overrides it — unknown, since no turn selects it and the user's turns about it are complaints ("why the fuck are we even using qwen anymore, this is so stupid", turns:L1380; "qwen ia NIM is fucking uselessly slow", turns:L1328). _ANSWER_SCHEMA is derived — the answer is the only thing the generator owns, every other field being recorded by the harness. The generator runs at temperature 0 with enable_thinking False, max_tokens 8192, min_tokens 1 and a 480.0 s timeout, the last four unknown.

run.py — the CLI. ARMS (8 arm names) is derived from the modules under pipelines/. CHAR_BUDGET_ARMS (4 arm names) is which arms accept --char-budget for fill-to-budget retrieval — the arms whose answer_one_question takes a char_budget and consumes its own ranking to it (lucene, vector, artefact_v1, artefact_v1_det) — and any other arm fails at parse. The gold and 10smoke id-set files are the named fixed sets, with the gold file not being the one build_question_sets.py writes (6/100 overlap). The -k default reads orchestrator.DEFAULT_TOP_K; -n defaults to 5 and --workers to 1, both unknown; the rejudge worker auto-size is every cell at once because the shared judge pool is the real cap; the wide-parallel judge families are the subscription CLI lanes; the run-id timestamp format is ISO-8601 basic and the judge slug pattern is filesystem safety.

contract.py, progress.py, run_lock.py, abort.py, questions.py, prompt_tokens.py. GENERATOR_SYSTEM = "Answer the question using only the provided documents. Be concise." is the shared generator's system prompt, identical across arms — the fairness property is designed, the wording has no record. The progress bars set ascii and dynamic_ncols for the target terminal and disable themselves when output is captured. run_lock.py's two acquire attempts are one stale-clear then one attempt, with PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION 0x1000 and STILL_ACTIVE 259 borrowed from the Win32 API and .run.lock as the single-writer marker. abort.py polls at 0.1 s for q/Q. questions.py's QUESTIONS is the file build_questions.py writes. prompt_tokens.py's _TOKENIZER_ID = "Qwen/Qwen3-8B" follows the generator's family but not its checkpoint, and nothing records whether the tokenizers are identical.

nim.py — transport, pacing, retries. BASE_URL is NVIDIA's published endpoint and NVIDIA_API_KEY plus the NVIDIA_API_KEY_WORKER_* pool are the credentials; the pacing, retry, timeout and batch constants are mostly unknown, and NIM_SECONDS_BETWEEN_CALLS is one of the two rows carrying a disagreement between its value and the comment beside it.

eval/ragas.py — the judge lane. JUDGE_BACKEND is derived, read off the judge slug at import, and the judge defaults to claude-haiku-4-5 through the headless Claude CLI. Three rows describe _check_judge_context_budget, a function no call site invokes: MAX_JUDGE_CONTEXT_CHARS, _CONTEXT_HEAVY_LLM and the [:8] report cut.

eval/ragas_catalog.py. CATALOG holds the full RAGAS metric menu with per-metric flags for whether HERB can feed it and whether it needs a judge; SELECTED is the judged opt-in, and context_precision_llm_ref stays commented out because it is ~k judge calls per question.

Top-level scripts. build_question_sets.py's GOLD_N = 100 and GOLD_SEED = 0 are unknown, and the shipped data/gold100.jsonl is not reproducible from the script (6/100 overlap), so the constants do not describe the set in use; its equal-allocation round-robin is a design trade the docstring argues for itself. truncate_k.py's --ks default 5,10,15,20,30,40,50 is user-specified (turns:L221). reembed_herb_eval.py reads the herb-eval-backup sibling for description text, writes in batches of 500, drops the six legacy per-facet indexes and seven properties, and creates both vector indexes with cosine similarity. build_tag_clusters.py's MAX_ITER 60 and TOL 1e-7 are unknown. build_facet_layer.py carries the derived layer's whole build: DERIVED_NN_K 25, DERIVED_MIN_CLASS 20, DERIVED_SEED_PARITY 0, FACET_PRIOR / HERB_FACET_PRIOR 0.5, EMB_BATCH 2000, COS_BLOCK 2000, WRITE_BATCH 1000, the 15-pattern REGISTER the evidence facet reads a chunk's kind from, PER_CHARS 1000.0 (an arithmetic identity the per-feature z-score divides out exactly), MIN_NAME_CHARS 6, MAX_NAME_TOKENS 5, the -ing suffix seeding the activity axis, and the ICC and sd floors. backup_facet_weights.py names the entry build_facet_layer.py reads before it writes. The remaining scripts — ablate_boost.py, offline_eval.py, compare_arms.py, export_raw.py, model_test.py, judge_probe.py — are one-off or reporting tools, and compare_arms.py's DIR_RE does not match the run-folder naming scheme it exists to read, so the cross-arm table printer has never displayed the artefact.
